name: s3_read_turn_sort
goal: Try to read the label with the head camera; if not readable, WALLX turns the parcel to show its other side and the harness reads again; then (demo: hardcoded 420/90024/001 if still unread) red lane -> right arm puts it into the red bin, left arm locked.
setup: IQBAR standing on its long narrow side, long axis front-to-back, right of centre, about 15 cm in front of the red bin, label facing away from the camera; bins on their marks; arms at rest.

wording.INSPECT: turn the IQBAR box around so its other side faces the camera
wording.PLACE: put the IQBAR box into the {mat} bin
wording.HOME: put both arms back to the home position
wording.LIFT2: use both arms to squeeze the short ends of the IQBAR box, lift it up and put it into the {mat} bin

notes: Read -> turn (INSPECT) -> read -> demo code -> right arm (left locked) puts it into red. Grippers open fully while WALLX opens them. Run 1 (box flat) failed: one gripper cannot hold the flat 102 mm box; auto flat/standing detection is too noisy (111-198 px), so orientation is part of the setup.
